qwen-copilot.config.title: Qwen Models for GitHub Copilot Chat
qwen-copilot.config.apiMode.description:
Which Qwen API mode to use.

- **Coding Plan** — use your Qwen Token Plan subscription.
- **Standard API** — use DashScope pay-as-you-go access.

Both modes use OpenAI-compatible endpoints by default and can be overridden with `baseUrl`.
qwen-copilot.config.apiMode.codingPlan.d: Use your Qwen Token Plan subscription. Default endpoint: `token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com/compatible-mode/v1`.
qwen-copilot.config.apiMode.standard.des: Pay-as-you-go access via DashScope. The active endpoint is chosen by `region` unless `baseUrl` is set.
qwen-copilot.config.region.description:
Server region for default endpoints (ignored when `baseUrl` is set).

- **International** — Token Plan: `token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com/compatible-mode/v1`; Standard: `dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
- **Mainland China** — Token Plan: `token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com/compatible-mode/v1`; Standard: `dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`
qwen-copilot.config.region.china.label: Mainland China
qwen-copilot.config.baseUrl.description: Override the Qwen API base URL. When set, this value is used verbatim and both `apiMode` and `region` are ignored. Use this for self-hosted proxies or compatible third-party endpoints.
qwen-copilot.config.maxTokens.descriptio: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to `0` to use the API default (no explicit limit). Useful for controlling costs.
qwen-copilot.config.maxRetries.descripti: Maximum automatic retries for transient chat failures (HTTP 429 rate limits and 5xx server errors), not counting the initial attempt. Set to `0` to disable automatic retries and fail fast. Retries wait with exponential backoff and honor the server's `Retry-After` header.
qwen-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides.des: Remap a built-in model id sent to the API. Keys are picker ids (for example `qwen-plus`), values are API ids. Use this for proxy/workspace-specific model aliases.
qwen-copilot.config.customModels.descrip: Add custom models to the picker. Each entry is either a model id string (for example `"qwen-plus"`) or an object like `{ "id": "my-model", "name": "My Model" }`. Custom models always appear in the picker.
qwen-copilot.config.enableModelDiscovery: Automatically discover available model IDs from the current endpoint (`GET /models`) and show them in the model picker.
qwen-copilot.config.thinking.description:
Whether Qwen uses step-by-step reasoning before answering. Applies to models that support thinking.

- **On** — higher quality on complex coding and agent tasks (slower).
- **Off** — faster responses for simple edits.
qwen-copilot.config.debugLogging.descrip: Enable verbose debug logging to the Qwen output channel. Use [`Qwen: Show Logs`](command:qwen-copilot.showLogs) to view the channel. Logs may include request metadata but not prompt text.
qwen-copilot.config.usageRefreshInterval: How often (in minutes) to refresh usage data. Minimum 1, maximum 1440 (24 hours).
qwen-copilot.config.showUsageStatusBar.d: Show the Qwen usage status-bar item.
qwen-copilot.config.tokenPlanStatsEndpoi: Optional override for Token Plan usage endpoint. Leave empty to use built-in endpoint candidates.
